claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Explicit six-dimensional prototype gauges SU4 x SU2R x SU2L plus U1V. Scalars Phi (PS singlet, V-charged), chi=(15,1,1),chiprime=(4,2,1),H=(1,2,2). Per generation six-dimensional chiral Q=(4,1,2),Qbar=(bar4,1,2),Qc=(bar4,2,1),Qbarc=(4,2,1). Bulk masses via Phi Q Qbar + Phi* Qc Qbarc; localized zero modes are derived, not extra simultaneous bulk fields.

Earlier generic vortex U1 can be global or gauged; the realistic Section3.4 explicitly introduces the gauge factor. Source does not tabulate a unique complete set of U1V individual charges, scalar reality conditions or an unambiguous D3 chiral-node assignment. Do not import four-dimensional all-LH SM weights into six-dimensional spinors.

source_descriptions.reason: Per-field U1V charges, scalar field reality and canonical six-dimensional spinor orientation not established; interactions constrain sums, not all individual assignments. No numeric-subset normalization.
